strategy: Plan A: commission or obtain verified real-instrument recordings first; use public CC0/compatible sources only when the original recording and instrument authenticity are clear. Suno or other AI music tools are not accepted as instrument sample sources.

global_requirements.delivery_format: wav or aiff, 48 kHz or 44.1 kHz, 24-bit preferred, mono or stereo accepted before mastering
global_requirements.allowed_content: single notes, short idiomatic phrase, open-string/scale color, percussion hits or rolls as appropriate
not_allowed: background music with unclear composition rights
environmental noise that obscures the instrument

priority_groups.name: critical_listening_risk
priority_groups.reason: Professional users can immediately detect fake huqin, sheng, and suona timbres.

priority_groups.name: core_orchestra_coverage
priority_groups.reason: These are central sound families and need real attacks, resonances, and playing gestures.

priority_groups.name: percussion_completion
priority_groups.reason: Percussion samples are easier to commission cleanly but still need correct instruments.
